content: We generated sentences from the templates by replacing INLINEFORM0 person INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 emotion word INLINEFORM3 variables with the values they can take. In total, 8,640 sentences were generated with the various combinations of INLINEFORM4 person INLINEFORM5 and INLINEFORM6 emotion word INLINEFORM7 values across the eleven templates. We manually examined the sentences to make sure they were grammatically well-formed. Notably, one can derive pairs of sentences from the EEC such that they differ only in one word corresponding to gender or race (e.g., `My daughter feels devastated' and `My son feels devastated'). We refer to the full set of 8,640 sentences as Equity Evaluation Corpus.
